pretreatment: RCA cleaning, HF treatment, DI water rinse, N2 blow
evidence: P-type Si(100) substrates (resistivity: 1–10X/C1 cm, 20 /C2 20 mm 2) were cleaned according to Radio Corporation of America (RCA) standard cleaning procedure (SC-1), followed by an HF treatment to reduce the native oxide, and finally rinsed by DI water and dried by N2 blow.
